He probably means aide.''"<br>"''He means lover.''"<br>"''That too.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Kassar Forge]]|<ref name="Wedge's Gamble>''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
'''Cutter''' was a [[Spice/Legends|spicer]] term used to describe a person who prepared [[Spice/Legends|spice]] for use or sale. It was also applied to someone who was close enough to a person that they could be trusted with cutting their spice. The term, often used on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], was also used to describe the lover of a spicer, as in the case between [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal [[Zekka Thyne]] and [[Inyri Forge]].<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />
